title: Bottle Your Hearts
description: High-risk heart trading system where players can bottle their hearts, trade them, and face permanent death bans. Includes revival tokens and admin commands.
body:
# Bottle Your Hearts

A high-stakes survival plugin where players can bottle their hearts to trade, but dying at minimum health results in a **permanent ban**.

## 🫙 How It Works

**Bottling Hearts:**
- Hold a glass bottle and shift + right-click
- Select 1-10 hearts to bottle from the interactive menu
- Your max health is **permanently reduced**
- Heart bottles can be traded with other players

**Using Heart Bottles:**
- Right-click a heart bottle to consume it
- Gain the stored hearts back (up to max cap)
- Give bottles to other players to help them

**Death Penalty:**
- If you die while at **1 heart maximum health**, you are **permanently banned**
- No respawn, no second chances
- Creates high-risk, high-reward gameplay

## ✦ Revival System

**Craft Revival Tokens:**
- 4 Diamond Blocks + 2 Enchanted Golden Apples + 2 Gold Blocks + 1 Nether Star
- Right-click to see list of banned players
- Click a name to revive them with 3 hearts
- Single-use item

## 🎮 Admin Commands

- `/revive <player>` - Revive a banned player (spawns with 3 hearts)
- `/givehearts <player> <amount>` - Give hearts to online players
- `/hearts [player]` - Check current and max heart count
- Tab completion shows only banned players for `/revive`

## ⚙️ Configuration

Fully configurable in `config.yml`:
- Minimum hearts players must keep (default: 1)
- Maximum heart cap (default: 20)
- Max hearts per bottle (default: 10)
- Permanent ban toggle
- Temporary ban duration
- Custom ban messages

## 💬 Support & Feedback

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Join our Discord server to report issues and share feedback!

---

Perfect for hardcore survival servers, SMP communities, and players who want meaningful consequences for their actions!
